content.text: Skip to Main Content Campus Maps High Point University > Visitor Information > Campus Maps With 112 buildings on 430 acres, High Point University is located a mile from downtown High Point. Interstate highways 40 and 85 are easily accessible from the campus, and the area airport is a few miles north of the campus. Since 2005 alone, HPU has invested more than $1.6 billion in academics, facilities, student life, technology and scholarships. The original 92-acre campus has grown to 430 – with 90 new or recently renovated academic buildings, residence halls, athletic stadiums and student life facilities. The result is an engaging environment that encourages students to excel. The university has plans for further development of its facilities as it continues to prepare students for the world as it is going to be. For a complete list of buildings and facilities on campus, please visit our online campus tour. To view and download a campus map please visit the website here. ShareThis Copy and Paste
